errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps labels, percentages, and colors for the majority of the slices. For instance: SCIFACT is 0.1%, not 16.1% (which is FEVER); SNLI is orange, not green; VITAMINC is 13.0%, not MULTINC; SCITAIL is 1.2%, not 11.3% (which is MULTINLI). The list contains numerous such errors, including listing FACTCC twice with incorrect data.
